annotation.title_clean: Accelerating Physical AI: Embodied Intelligence for the Next Frontier of AI-Powered Robotics
annotation.title_en: Accelerating Physical AI: Embodied Intelligence for the Next Frontier of AI-Powered Robotics
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Innovation Council (European Commission), via CORDIS
annotation.summary_en: CORDIS page for a 2026 European Innovation Council Challenge funding Physical AI and embodied robotics solutions for disaster response, autonomous labs and robot assistants. It expects Responsible AI, trustworthiness and compliance with the AI Act, framed mainly as promoting European technological sovereignty and competitiveness.
key_provisions_or_claims: Funds Physical AI solutions combining at least two of five listed characteristics, such as perception, learning and human-AI collaboration.
Target applications: disaster response, autonomous labs, personal or professional robot assistants.
Solutions should follow Responsible AI, trustworthiness, security and human-centrism principles.
Expected to support the AI Act and Apply AI Strategy.
Applicants need a lab-tested prototype and an end-user letter of intent.
